enabled.description: Enable CockroachDB. Exactly one of CockroachDB, YugabyteDB and Raft should be enabled (only one at a time).

tag.description: Version tag of the CockroachDB image. Until DSS v0.16, the recommended CockroachDB version is `v21.2.7`. From DSS v0.17, the recommended CockroachDB version is `v24.1.3`.

join.description: List of already-existing CockroachDB instances. If empty, the chart will automatically discover the internal nodes. If set to join a DSS Region and other DSS instance, please add the addresses of the statefulset's pod as well.

args.description:
Additional argument passed to the statefulset pod command. In the context of the dss deployment it requires the following arguments:
 `--locality-advertise-addr=zone=example@$(hostname -f)`
`--advertise-addr=${HOSTNAME##*-}.db.example.com`

storageClass.description: Storage class depending on your cloud provider.

enabled.description: Enable YugabyteDB. Exactly one of CockroachDB, YugabyteDB and Raft should be enabled (only one at a time).

placement_cloud.description: Name of the cloud where instances are deployed, in a recommended deployment should be set to 'dss'

placement_region.description: Name of the region where instances are deployed, in a recommended deployment should be set to your organization's name

placement_zone.description: Name of the zone where instances are deployed, in a recommended deployment should be set to 'zone'

masterAddresses.description: A comma-separated list of master addresses to use. For a local cluster, you can omit it to use the default values, if you join an existing cluster you need to set it the list of public addresses of all master yugabyte nodes

enabled.description: Enable the Raft-based datastore. Exactly one of raft, cockroachdb or yugabyte should be enabled (only one at a time).

endpoint.description: Address (host:port, no scheme) of the node at which the node's Raft listener is reachable by its peers.

nodes.description: The DSS nodes (Raft voters) deployed by this release. Do not reorder or insert entries once the pool has been bootstrapped: the pod's persistent volume is bound to its position in the list.

clusterID.description: Raft cluster ID. Must be identical on all nodes of the pool.

tlsSecret.description: Name of the Secret (in the release namespace) holding the mutual TLS material of the Raft listeners: node.raft-<i>.crt/node.raft-<i>.key is the certificate of the pod of ordinal <i> of this release, ca.crt is the PEM bundle of the CAs of every participant of the pool, including its own.

automaticBootstrap.description: Form the Raft groups automatically: the first node of this release bootstraps them, then the other nodes of this release and the nodes of automaticBootstrapNodes are added to them one at a time, retrying until all of them are members. Only meant for automation: enable it only for the first nodes of a cluster, otherwise independent Raft groups are created.

automaticBootstrapNodes.description: Addresses (host:port, no scheme) of the Raft listeners of the nodes of other participants to add to the Raft groups with automaticBootstrap.

size.description: PVC size for the Raft data.

storageClass.description: Storage class depending on your cloud provider. Empty for the cluster default.

raft.description: Load balancers of the Raft nodes deployed by this release: exactly one entry per raft.nodes entry, matched by index (the first entry matches the first node).

certName.description: Optional: ARN of the certificate for AWS only

sslPolicy.description: For Google only: If provided, this SSL Policy is applied to the DSS Gateway Ingress

preSharedCert.description: For Google only: If provided, this pre-shared certificate is used by the DSS Gateway Ingress instead of a Google-managed certificate

image.description: Image of the DSS. Please note that the usage of the `latest` tag is discouraged to prevent accidental upgrades in case of restart. Example: `docker.io/interuss/dss:v0.15.0`. Official image releases: https://hub.docker.com/r/interuss/dss/tags

imagePullSecret.description: Optional: Name of the secret holding the credentials to pull the DSS image. Example: `private-registry-credentials`

cpuRequest.description: Kubernetes CPU request of the core-service containers. Not set if empty. Example: `0.5`

memoryRequest.description: Kubernetes memory request of the core-service containers. Not set if empty. Example: `2Gi`

cpuLimit.description: Kubernetes CPU limit of the core-service containers. Not set if empty. Example: `0.5`

memoryLimit.description: Kubernetes memory limit of the core-service containers. Not set if empty. Example: `2Gi`

psp.description: Optional: Pod Security Policy RoleBinding granting the ClusterRole `roleRef` to all service accounts of the namespace.

roleRef.description: Name of the ClusterRole to bind.

env.description: Additional environment variables of the core-service containers. Example: `[{name: GOGC, value: '80'}]`

image.description: Optional: Image used by the schema manager and evict jobs. Defaults to `dss.image`.

desiredRidDbVersion.description: Desired RID DB schema version. When empty, the latest version for the datastore is used. Example: `4.1.0`

desiredScdDbVersion.description: Desired SCD DB schema version. When empty, the latest version for the datastore is used. Example: `3.4.1`

desiredAuxDbVersion.description: Desired AUX DB schema version. When empty, the latest version for the datastore is used. Example: `1.1.0`

dumpRequests.description: Log full HTTP request and response. Intended only for debugging and/or development.

hostname.description: Public hostname of the dss. Example: dss.example.com

publicEndpoint.description: Public endpoint of the dss. Example: https://dss.example.com. Only for dss version >= 0.21.0, otherwise left this value empty.

locality.description: Locality attribute for this deployment. Example: zone=example

gcpProfServiceName.description: Optional: Service name for the Go profiler.

schedule.description: In cron format (https://crontab.guru/). Leave empty to run daily at 2 AM at a minute deterministically derived from the locality.

timeout.description: Go duration format (https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration). Empty to use the command default.

limit.description: Maximum number of entities deleted (per type) per run. 0 means unlimited.

batchSize.description: Number of entities deleted per batch query (per type) by each run Set to 0 to delete all expired entities in a single query (per type).
